title: [UI][Sorting] Changing the sort does not reload the page
precondition: Standard user is logged in and is on the Products page. The browser DevTools console is open. Assumption: "immediately" means the new order is visible with no action beyond choosing the option; a time limit is not tested (pending product owner answer).

steps.expected: The URL is the Products page URL

steps.action: In the DevTools console run: window.__sortMarker = 1
steps.expected: The console prints 1. This marker disappears if the page reloads, so it is the proof of no reload (the URL alone is not, because a reload keeps the same URL)
The list is re-ordered with Sauce Labs Fleece Jacket first, with no further action

steps.action: Read the URL, then run window.__sortMarker in the console
steps.expected: The URL is unchanged and the console prints 1 (the page was not reloaded)

steps.action: Select "Name (Z to A)", then run window.__sortMarker in the console
Select "Price (low to high)", then run window.__sortMarker in the console
Select "Name (A to Z)", then run window.__sortMarker in the console
steps.expected: The console prints 1 after all four options were used

gherkin:
Given I am on the Products page and have set a page marker
When I select each of the four sort options in turn
Then the list is re-ordered every time
And the URL is unchanged
And the marker is still set, proving the page was never reloaded
